name: Embarcadero Center
text: Embarcadero Center is a commercial complex of four office towers, two hotels, and a shopping center located in San Francisco. An outdoor ice skating rink is open in the center  during winter months. Embarcadero Center sits on a 9.8-acre (4.0 ha) site largely bounded by Clay Street (to the north), Sacramento Street (to the south), Battery Street (to the west), and the Embarcadero (to the east).

depictions.name: Embarcadero Center
depictions.text: The Embarcadero Center is a location in Watch Dogs 2.
